summary: Delivery audit of the whole Kiln Phase Model Tiers PRD at 622a4c7. Three rounds ran. 20 of 26 criteria are fully built. Six are built only in part: AC-AGENTS-02, AC-AGENTS-03, AC-PICK-03, AC-PICK-06, AC-PICK-07 and AC-FALLBACK-03. They miss the billing reason at Start, two account marks, where a stop's choice came from and where to change it, Change at a preflight stop, offline kiln handoff, and the fallback facts after a carry-on session. Phase 5 was added to build them. No criterion was amended and nothing was changed outside the requirements.
